1_mythic_closure.description: The final book should fulfill the arc of the Major Arcana itself—from The Fool to The World.
mechanics: The Fool’s leap is finally understood in hindsight.
The journey of transformation is synthesized.
The protagonist(s) embody The World: unity, integration, transcendence.

2_temporal_harmony.description: Time reaches a stable or meaningful endpoint after being broken or looped.
mechanics: Key paradoxes are resolved or reframed.
Characters accept or unify their divergent selves.
A timeline is selected, restored, or recreated with intent.

3_thematic_resolution.description: The central themes are fully embodied in final decisions.
mechanics: Free will vs. determinism → chosen self-limitation.
Divine vs. Human agency → reclaiming or rejecting divine influence.
Knowledge vs. Wisdom → choosing myth or mystery over control.

4_emotional_catharsis.description: Readers feel the cost and beauty of the journey.
mechanics: A major character dies meaningfully.
A love (romantic or symbolic) is fulfilled.
A reunion, goodbye, or revelation lands emotionally.

5_symbolic_recurrence.description: The ending rhymes with the beginning in a poetic or mirrored fashion.
mechanics: Book 1 symbols/images return transformed.
The story ends where it began, in a new key.
Final line mirrors or inverts Book 1's opening.

6_sacrifice_and_inheritance.description: Something irrevocable is sacrificed and something transformational is inherited.
mechanics: A protagonist gives up power, immortality, or memory.
A successor or symbolic heir emerges.
A legacy or burden is passed on.

7_cosmic_consequence.description: The universe changes based on the protagonists’ choices.
mechanics: A divine hierarchy is rewritten.
Timelines collapse or become myth.
The world forgets—but the reader remembers.

8_meta_literary_loop.description: The story’s telling becomes part of the story itself.
mechanics: Final act involves the writing or recording of the tale.
A character becomes the chronicler.
Trionfi cards or a text become the record of events.

9_ambiguous_illumination.description: Not everything is explained, but everything feels resolved.
mechanics: Final scenes provoke wonder, not confusion.
The reader closes with awe, not frustration.
Encourages reflection and re-reading for deeper insight.
